blocker_resolution.contradiction_statement: GOV-03 summary erroneously stated TS-MDL-5321 = Sirpur (T) -> TS-MDL-4340 (LGD 5321). This was a material conflation with the accepted R4 forensic matrix.
blocker_resolution.forensic_correction: TS-MDL-5321 is Mancherial (pilot LGD 5321 in M042, erroneous LGD 4664 in M043), with canonical counterpart TS-MDL-4354 (Mancherial, authentic MoPR LGD 4354). Sirpur (T) is TS-MDL-7101 (pilot LGD 7101 in M042, erroneous LGD 4676 in M043), with canonical counterpart TS-MDL-4315 (Sirpur (T), authentic MoPR LGD 4315). TS-MDL-4340 is Tanoor (Nirmal district, LGD 4340) and has no relation to Sirpur (T) or Mancherial.

provenance_semantics.historical_linkage_decision: The original historical linkage in record_provenance_linkages MUST retain domain_record_id = LEGACY_ID and set is_canonical = false. It must NOT be repointed to canonical ID.
reasons: Preserves the historical source claim made in ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1.
Preserves the historical reality that the pilot identity existed in the system.
Explicitly marks it noncanonical using native is_canonical boolean column.
Avoids rewriting historical source claims into false retroactive statements.
Does not violate foreign key constraints (record_provenance_linkages.domain_record_id is polymorphic text).

append_only_dag_design.model: SOURCE DATASET -> ORIGINAL PROVENANCE RECORD -> (OLD LINKAGE is_canonical=false) -> SUPERSESSION PROVENANCE RECORD -> CANONICAL DOMAIN IDENTITY (is_canonical=true via 2026 ingest node)

dataset_version_immutability.rule: ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1 is 100% immutable. Zero UPDATE statements permitted.

canonical_621_proof.one_to_one_reconciliation: All 12 pilot identities represent real-world entities that already exist as canonical active anchors (e.g. TS-MDL-5321 is Mancherial, which exists as TS-MDL-4354). They represent 0 additional statutory entities.

geography_entity_lineage_treatment.split_reality: Row 68e465c2-a00b-478d-8082-e0cf1f3bbe67 represents a genuine statutory split: Hajipur Mandal carved out of Mancherial Mandal under G.O.Ms.No. 222 on 11.10.2016.
geography_entity_lineage_treatment.reconciliation: Preserve the split transition and statutory order. Update internal UUIDs to canonical mandal UUIDs. Update metadata to include both canonical IDs (TS-MDL-4354, TS-MDL-6227) and legacy pilot IDs (TS-MDL-5321, TS-MDL-5329).
geography_entity_lineage_treatment.provenance_record_reconciliation: Row 8c350901-a5d8-fe3d-c5b2-6ffe37601908 in provenance_records updated to reference canonical IDs in metadata while preserving pilot IDs.

operation_1.name: Mark Historical Linkages Non-Canonical
operation_1.precondition: Exactly 12 rows in record_provenance_linkages for mandals with domain_record_id in legacy IDs and is_canonical = true.
operation_1.operation: UPDATE record_provenance_linkages SET is_canonical = false WHERE domain_table = 'mandals' AND domain_record_id IN (...) AND is_canonical = true;
operation_1.postcondition: All 12 rows retain domain_record_id = LEGACY_ID with is_canonical = false.

operation_2.name: Insert Append-Only Supersession Provenance Nodes
operation_2.precondition: The 12 legacy provenance records exist in provenance_records.
operation_2.operation: INSERT INTO provenance_records (id, dataset_version_id, source_record_id, parent_provenance_id, status, transformation_type, operator, metadata) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
operation_2.postcondition: 12 supersession nodes link legacy provenance nodes to 2026 dataset version.

operation_3.operation: UPDATE metadata to include canonical cross-references alongside legacy pilot IDs.
